strategy.summary: CART-31 reports two mispricings in cartTotal (src/cart.js). Reading the code: bulkDiscount uses `itemCount(items) > BULK_THRESHOLD` (line 22) though BULK_THRESHOLD's doc says "at least this many", so a 10-item cart gets no discount — this should reproduce. The SAVE5 report looks already guarded: cartTotal clamps goods with Math.max(0, …) (line 31), so a $3 cart with SAVE5 should come to $4.99; the test asserts that and, if it passes, the finding is that the code doesn't reproduce it.
inScope: cartTotal bulk discount at exactly 10 items
cartTotal with SAVE5 on a cart cheaper than the coupon
assumptions: $100 for 10x$10 includes no shipping because the goods ($90 after discount) reach FREE_SHIPPING_FROM ($50), so the right total is exactly $90.00 as the ticket says.
The ticket's $3 cart is one line of price 3, quantity 1.
openQuestions: The SAVE5 report: the current code clamps goods at 0 (src/cart.js:31); if the test passes, the report may need other steps (another cart shape) or was fixed already.

risks.description: The negative-total report may not reproduce on current code
risks.mitigation: Test asserts the ticket's expected $4.99 with the ticket's data; a pass is reported as the finding, not forced to fail.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A cart of 10 items (one line, quantity 10 at $10) totals $90.00: the bulk discount applies from 10 items.
A $3 cart with coupon SAVE5 totals $4.99: goods never cost less than $0, shipping $4.99 is added.

testCases.title: applies the bulk discount to a cart of exactly 10 items
testCases.expected: Returns 90; today it fails with 'expected 100 to be 90' because bulkDiscount uses > instead of >= BULK_THRESHOLD (src/cart.js:22).
testCases.rationale: Reproduces symptom 1 at the lowest level.

testCases.title: charges only shipping when SAVE5 exceeds a $3 cart
testCases.expected: Returns 4.99 (never negative). Expected to pass on current code given the Math.max clamp at src/cart.js:31; a pass is reported as not reproduced.
testCases.testData: one line price 3 quantity 1, coupon SAVE5
testCases.rationale: Reproduces (or shows fixed) symptom 2 with the ticket's data.

strategy.environmentNotes: No services; pure unit tests via `npm test` (vitest run).

defects.title: No bulk discount for a cart of exactly 10 items
defects.description: CART-31 / AC1: a cart of 10 items (one line, quantity 10 at $10) should total $90.00 because the bulk discount applies from 10 items. Instead cartTotal returns $100.00. Cause: bulkDiscount in src/cart.js:22 checks `itemCount(items) > BULK_THRESHOLD` where the threshold's own doc says "at least this many", so it should be `>=`.
defects.evidence: AssertionError: expected 100 to be 90 // Object.is equality (test/cart-total.test.js:11)
